name: Real footage: mouse on a cable
description: Real phone footage: a computer mouse hanging on its cable in front of a mesh chair back. The reference is an ID-1 card (85.6 mm long side, same size as a credit card) on the ledge below; its face is blurred for privacy. This rig can only swing to about 20° before the mouse leaves the frame.

proposal.feasibility_note: Recommend 20° because it is the feasible setting with the largest physical effect (0% difference in the predicted observable) among settings that separate the models by ≥10σ. Expected separation 759.4σ RMS (max 1194σ) after the 0.5 s conditioning window. Searched only up to 20°, the most this setup allows.
proposal.filming_instructions: Release the same pendulum from 20° (string taut, bob at rest), keep the camera and the reference object exactly where they were, and record at least 6 full swings.
